name: Domain-Specific Chromatic Formulation
description: Replaced the explicit graph-theoretic equality conditions with a domain-specific constraint about the minimum number of vessels required for safe transport. This is logically equivalent to requiring the induced subgraph of the 3 materials to have a chromatic number of 3, which for a 3-vertex graph strictly means it must be a triangle (3-clique). This forces the model to perform a non-trivial reduction from the domain logic to graph coloring and finally to clique detection, defeating superficial pattern matching.
